task: Analyze the students' scores in data/score.xlsx by calculating the average scores for each student (grouping by student name if repeated entries exist) and add a new sheet to the Excel file named 'Summary' containing these average scores. Then, generate a summary report in a new Word file named 'score_analysis.docx'. The Word report must include a table listing each student's name alongside their computed average score, and a brief discussion highlighting which student(s) have the highest and lowest average scores.
query_sentence: Provide an in-depth analysis of the student scores data, including computed averages and summary insights, and document your findings appropriately.

ground_truth_memory.content: The average score for each student must be calculated by grouping all rows with the same name and averaging their midterm1 and midterm2 scores.
A new sheet named 'Summary' must be added to the original Excel file to record each student's name and their computed average score.
Create a new Word document named 'score_analysis.docx' for the summary report.
The Word report must contain a table of all students and their average scores and include a brief discussion highlighting which student(s) achieved the highest and lowest averages.
